newsitem.title: BRAZIL: High voltage wire kills child in Brazil jail.
newsitem.headline: High voltage wire kills child in Brazil jail.

text.p: A high voltage security wire killed a boy and seriously injured another child playing on the roof of a Brazilian prison, officials said on Monday.

An official of the Penitentiary of Goiania said 6-year-old Jonathas Jesus Martins da Silva died on the way to a hospital on Sunday after touching the 11,000-volt cable running across the roof of a building in the prison to prevent escapes.
Jonathas Soares Oliveira, 8, was hospitalized in serious condition, he added.

"They were visiting relatives and their mothers let them play around in the yard. It seems they climbed a tree to the roof and ignored warnings from guards and prisoners about the danger," the official said by telephone from Goiania.
Valdir Morgado, the jail's spokesman, said the chances of Soares surviving were extremely slim.

Relatives of the dead child told local media they would sue prison authorities, saying the wire was "excessive" and guards should have prevented the tragedy. But prison officials said the children were warned about the cable and blamed the boys' parents for allowing them to run free.
